objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "If you are viewing a Markdown file, click the file name, such as Readme.md, to return to the view with Markdown formatting applied."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Readme.md'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Readme.md'; role=link; text="Readme.md" | HINTS: container=Folders and files table
actions.instr: Clicking Readme.md in the Folders and files table

actions.intent: whether a main heading on the page you end on is present (in the main content area)
actions.instr: Checking whether the page has a main heading
If-else checkpoint cp_1: condition 'The page you end on has a main heading.' matched
